background: Northern Trust Corporation is the holding company of a Chicago-based custodian and wealth manager, earning fees from asset servicing for institutions and from managing money for wealthy families and foundations.
synthesis: The group is rated A+ on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A, all on a stable outlook. Capital is mixed against US banks, with CET1 of 12.0% just below the peer median but leverage of 8.5% in the top quarter; since 31 Mar 2025 CET1 has fallen 0.9 points and leverage 0.6 points. Liquidity is the weak spot, with LCR of 107% in the bottom quarter. The only flagged items, both on 22 Jul 2026, are strong second-quarter results with earnings ahead of estimates.
